answer: Cosignatures are collected in anchor, verified in dune, and bridge names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 2 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 32 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. That bill is paid per identity, so 335 aliases cost 300 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
